item.title: India's $100 Million Microreactor Gambit Reshapes Power Dynamics
item.dc:creator: Amarjeet Singh
item.description:
Can a Bengaluru startup deliver factory-made nuclear microreactors for just $100 million by 2031? We analyze Daratha Atomics' high-stakes gamble on industrial power.
[SPLIT] ⚡ The projected $100 million project cost represents roughly 10 percent of comparable US and European microreactor benchmarks. [SPLIT] ⚡ The compact footprint—measuring 20 by 8 by 8 meters—is tailored for energy-intensive nodes like data centers and fabrication plants. item.title: Dismantling Bhatti's Terror Network Amid a Pivot to Religious Radicalization
item.dc:creator: Amarjeet Singh
item.description:
Indian agencies arrested 700 operatives linked to terrorist Shahzad Bhatti. Now, intelligence reveals a dangerous new pivot toward religious radicalization and encrypted comms. Read the deep-dive intelligence brief from Neodymium World.
[SPLIT] ⚡ The network is pivoting from purely financial incentives to religious-centric recruitment combined with false promises of overseas relocation. [SPLIT] ⚡ Bhatti, proscribed under the UAPA, operates from safe havens in Pakistan, Dubai, and Portugal while managing cross-border logistics. [SPLIT] 🔗 Read full report → https://neodymium.world/articles/dismantling-bhatti-s-terror-network-amid-a-pivot-to-religious-radicalization-048934.html
